name: Corrections to the AiGovOps Verified AI Harms corpus, batch 2026-W24
prepared_by: Claude (AI agent), at Bob Rapp's request
rule: The signed batch is never edited. Each correction names the case, the field, the exact value it replaces and the evidence. scripts/apply-corrections.mjs refuses to run if the batch's hash or any old value does not match. Every page reads the corrected copy, verified-harms-current.json.
why: A link check on 16-17 Nov 2026 found 24 source links in this batch that did not resolve. The Wayback Machine had no copy of 21 of them, including pages at the BBC, CNN, NPR, The Verge, Wikipedia and gov.uk, which it archives heavily; so those links were most likely never real. Eleven cases had no working source left. Every replacement below was found by search and confirmed to resolve (or, for the BBC and two sites that refuse automated checks, confirmed through the Wayback Machine).
